scope: Integrated body+map-light-matched contact shadow atlases. Gameplay should not bind a separate soldier shadow layer for this package.

source_generation.method: built_in_imagegen body sources plus built_in_imagegen shadow source
source_generation.body_sources: Accepted TargetMatchV5 static facings and soldier_animation_v5 frames.
source_generation.postprocess: alpha shadow extraction, deterministic compositing of imagegen shadow under imagegen body frames, atlas packing, contact sheet, placement proof, metadata and validation

binding_mode.z_order: ground plate, baked body+shadow unit sprite, markers/health bars

assessment.player_shadow: Baked v7 player frames carry the lower-left map-light cast under the accepted TargetMatchV5 body; no runtime shadow transform is needed.
assessment.enemy_shadow: Baked v7 enemy frames carry the same map-light direction and should not fight the v6 plate baked wall/building shadows.
assessment.remaining: Needs PM/user visual approval and Gameplay runtime proof using baked atlases.
